designSummary: Before-after comparison within participating herds of observed core measures, with implementation outcomes described.
sampleSize: About 20 herds can be served with the vet time available. With a standard deviation of about 1.2 measures in the change from baseline, 20 herds give a 95 percent confidence interval of about 0.55 measures either side of the mean change, enough to tell a change of 1.5 from no change. The number of client dairy herds has not been stated, so reach cannot yet be projected.
primaryAnalysis: Mean change in the number of observed core measures from baseline to six months with a 95 percent confidence interval (paired analysis).
secondaryAnalysis: Adoption of each measure; delivery fidelity; reach by herd size and tenure; vet time per herd; farmer acceptability.
missingData: Herds that leave before six months are described; the primary analysis uses herds observed at both visits, with a sensitivity analysis counting missing follow-up as no change.
summary: About 20 herds give an interval of about half a measure around the mean change.
